Luxury 30A Beach Vacation Rental, 6BR Home with Private Pool & Gulf Views

Experience the best of Scenic Highway 30A at this luxury 6-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom beach home featuring a private pool, Gulf views, and a detached carriage house. Thoughtfully designed for families and groups, this elegant coastal retreat combines high-end finishes, modern amenities, and relaxed sophistication to create the ultimate 30A beach getaway.

Spacious & Stylish Interiors

Step inside an open-concept coastal oasis where natural light fills every space. The chef’s kitchen is a culinary dream, equipped with high-end stainless steel appliances, a large island with bar seating, and generous counter space for entertaining.

The living room offers plush seating, oversized windows, and a large flat-screen TV, the perfect gathering spot after a day of sunshine and sea breezes.

Bedroom Layout:

Primary Suite: King bed with spa-inspired ensuite bathroom

Two King Bedrooms: Elegantly furnished with luxurious linens

Queen Bedroom: Perfect for added versatility

Bunk Room: Queen-over-Queen bunks with a Twin trundle, ideal for kids or additional guests

Private Carriage House: King bedroom with kitchenette and full bathroom, perfect for in-laws, grandparents, or friends seeking extra privacy

Outdoor Paradise – Private Pool & Gulf Views

Relax and unwind in your own private outdoor oasis featuring a sparkling swimming pool, spacious sun deck, and comfortable lounge area. The outdoor kitchen is fully equipped with a gas grill and mini fridge, making al fresco dining effortless.

As the sun sets over the Gulf, enjoy breathtaking ocean views and the soothing sound of coastal breezes, the perfect ending to another day in paradise.

Prime 30A Location

Perfectly situated along Florida’s Scenic Highway 30A, this home offers easy access to the beach, dining, and entertainment. You’ll be just minutes from the sugar-white sands and turquoise waters of the Gulf of Mexico, with popular destinations like Seaside, Grayton Beach, and Rosemary Beach nearby.

Explore the coast with ease:

6-Seater Golf Cart included for cruising to the beach or local shops

Four Beach Cruiser Bikes provided for scenic rides along 30A’s paved trails

Book Your Dream 30A Beach Vacation Today

Whether you’re lounging by the pool, soaking up the Gulf views, or exploring the vibrant communities along 30A, this luxury beach home offers everything you need for a memorable escape.

At Modern Beach Vacation Rentals, we pride ourselves on delivering exceptional service and attention to detail that sets us apart. We look forward to hosting you and ensuring your 30A vacation is nothing short of perfect.

Book your stay today and experience the ultimate in Gulf Coast luxury living!
POOL HEAT
A $50.00 per day fee is added to reservations booked between October 1st - April 30th for Pool Heat. If you prefer to have an unheated pool, please email or call after booking and the fees will be immediately refunded.
PLEASE NOTE: The pool cannot be heated if it is below 52 degrees or above 80 degrees. As your stay gets closer, we will do our best to keep you informed of the forecast during that time period. We will immediately refund you if conditions do not allow for this.

You will find everything you need in the property to make the most of your time on the Emerald Coast. We offer a starter kit of premium, eco-friendly guest amenities including: Shampoo, Conditioner, Body and Face Soap, Toilet Paper, Facial Tissues, Dish Soap, Dishwasher Pods, Laundry Detergent, Paper Towels, Trash Bags, Dish Sponge, Bath Towels, and Bed linens.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
